data.narrative:
DNA Script is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $200M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public Biotech & Health comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers at similar or adjacent stages, with particular relevance to Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit—all Series C biotech firms.

Two valuation methods were applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised ($200M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yields $340M. Peer-median analysis across the three same-stage, same-sector private comparables produces $3.8B; the peer range spans $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (5.6x median across the three public tickers) cannot be applied given the absence of revenue disclosure for private-company targets.

The two applicable methods produce a wide triangulated range: $289M (low), $2.1B (median), and $4.4B (high). The stage-progression result sits below the peer median, reflecting a conservative read on early-stage fundraising trajectory. The peer-median method anchors the upper portion of the range but is subject to heterogeneity among the three comparables—Colossal Biosciences at $10.3B represents a significant outlier. Key uncertainties include the vintage and follow-on dynamics of the peer cohort, whether DNA Script's technology roadmap and competitive position justify positioning toward the median or lower-quartile range.
